{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state, o.order_status
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
),
buyers AS (SELECT customer_state, count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS buyers FROM q2 GROUP BY customer_state),
gmv AS (
  SELECT q.customer_state, sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM q2 q JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE q.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  GROUP BY q.customer_state
)
SELECT
  max(CASE WHEN b.customer_state='SP' THEN b.buyers END) AS sp_buyers,
  max(CASE WHEN b.customer_state='RJ' THEN b.buyers END) AS rj_buyers,
  max(CASE WHEN g.customer_state='SP' THEN g.gmv END) AS sp_gmv,
  max(CASE WHEN g.customer_state='RJ' THEN g.gmv END) AS rj_gmv,
  round(max(CASE WHEN b.customer_state='SP' THEN b.buyers END)::numeric
        / max(CASE WHEN b.customer_state='RJ' THEN b.buyers END), 2) AS buyers_ratio_sp_rj,
  round(max(CASE WHEN g.customer_state='SP' THEN g.gmv END)
        / max(CASE WHEN g.customer_state='RJ' THEN g.gmv END), 2) AS gmv_ratio_sp_rj,
  round(max(CASE WHEN g.customer_state='SP' THEN g.gmv END)
        - max(CASE WHEN g.customer_state='RJ' THEN g.gmv END), 2) AS gmv_diff_sp_minus_rj,
  round(max(CASE WHEN b.customer_state='SP' THEN b.buyers END)
        - max(CASE WHEN b.customer_state='RJ' THEN b.buyers END), 0) AS buyers_diff_sp_minus_rj
FROM buyers b JOIN gmv g USING(customer_state);"}

{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT order_id, order_status FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
),
items AS (
  SELECT sum(i.price) AS item_total, sum(i.freight_value) AS freight_total
  FROM q2 JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE q2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
),
pays AS (
  SELECT sum(p.payment_value) AS payment_total
  FROM q2 JOIN order_payments p USING(order_id)
  WHERE q2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
)
SELECT (SELECT item_total FROM items) AS item_total,
       (SELECT freight_total FROM items) AS freight_total,
       (SELECT payment_total FROM pays) AS payment_total,
       (SELECT payment_total FROM pays) - (SELECT item_total FROM items) AS payment_minus_item,
       (SELECT payment_total FROM pays) - (SELECT item_total + freight_total FROM items) AS payment_minus_item_freight,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM q2) AS order_count_all_status,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM q2 WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')) AS order_count_valid"}

{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT order_id, order_status FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
),
item_agg AS (
  SELECT i.order_id, sum(i.price) AS item_amt, sum(i.freight_value) AS freight_amt
  FROM q2 JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE q2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

),

  SELECT p.order_id, sum(p.payment_value) AS pay_amt, count(*) AS pay_rows
  FROM q2 JOIN order_payments p USING(order_id)
  WHERE q2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  GROUP BY p.order_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pay_agg WHERE pay_rows > 1) AS orders_multi_payment_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM item_agg) AS orders_with_items,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pay_agg) AS orders_with_payments,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM item_agg a FULL JOIN pay_agg b USING(order_id) WHERE a.order_id IS NULL OR b.order_id IS NULL) AS orders_only_one_side,

  (SELECT sum(pay_amt) FROM pay_agg) AS payment_total,

  (SELECT sum(freight_amt) FROM item_agg) AS freight_total,
  (SELECT round(100.0 * sum(freight_amt) / sum(item_amt), 2) FROM item_agg) AS freight_pct_of_item,

{"answer": "2018 年 Q2（按 order_purchase_timestamp 落在 2018-04-01 至 2018-06-30，排除 canceled / unavailable 状态）共 19,897 笔有效订单（含全部状态为 19,979 笔）：

- 商品金额（GMV，order_items.price 之和，不含运费）：2,849,730.26 BRL
- 运费（order_items.freight_value 之和）：472,586.99 BRL，相当于商品金额的 16.58%
- 支付金额（order_payments.payment_value 之和）：3,322,546.83 BRL，相当于商品金额的 116.59%

三者对比：支付金额比商品金额高 472,816.57 BRL，比“商品金额+运费”高 229.58 BRL。也就是说，支付金额与商品金额的差额几乎全部由运费解释（差额中 472,586.99 为运费，仅 229.58 为其他零星差异）。

为何不应把支付金额当作商品 GMV：
1. 口径不同。GMV 定义为 order_items.price 之和，明确不含 freight_value；支付金额是买家实付流水，天然包含运费，因此系统性偏高（本季度高 16.59%）。
2. 粒度不同。支付表一单多行（本季度有 524 笔订单存在多条支付记录，如分期/多支付方式），若直接与商品明细关联会重复计数，必须先按订单聚合再与商品聚合关联。

为何不应把支付金额当作商品 GMV：
1. 口径不同。GMV 定义为 order_items.price 之和，明确不含 freight_value；支付金额是买家实付流水，天然包含运费，因此系统性偏高（本季度高 16.59%）。

4. 状态过滤一致但含义不同。两者都排除了 canceled / unavailable，但支付金额反映资金流，GMV 反映成交商品价值，混用会同时污染规模与转化类指标。
